page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Left margin, beside the start of the third paragraph: two notes, "Libro 2." and "cap.2.". Printed page number top left.

l.i: comprobat.Nam neq; cernútur ab uno aliquo loco
ad certu finem omnes excurrere, neq; etiá posset ut [?]ul-
la ratione tanta molcs quieta cotineri. Quód si quæ
dá forte maria particularia uideantur ad unā metā
tendere, atq; unum sese exonerare in aliud uicinum,
proue nit sane id non ex fontibus unde oriuntur,
sed uel ex terræ atq; litoru dispositione, uel ex mul-
titudine & ui fluminum in id illabentium, uel ex
terræ atq; alueorum inæquali profunditate.
2. Si amplißimū mare ex fontibus ullis oriretur,
haud dubiè etiam ubi minora sunt maria, quale est
Hircanum & Caspium, ibi fontes aliqui conspice-
rentur. Sed istud nequaquam fit. Igitur intelligi nul-
lo modo potest, mare illud amplißimum ex fonti-
bus oriri.
Quod ad secundam opinionē attinet, complecti-
tur ea aliquid uerisimile, uidelicet aquas quasdam
educi sursum calore Solis. Verum absurda est per-
suasio, quòd aquæ ullæ à Sole absumantur, tanquam
si Sol ijs aleretur ac pascceretur. Existimarunt enim
quidā Platonici, Solem propterea & ab oriente in
occidentē, & à tropico Austrino ad Septentriona-
lem perpetuò ferri, ut nouū undiq; pabulū semper
hauriat. Cum enim immensus sit solis calor, necessa-
rio illū nouo humore subinde refici & conseruari,
ne consumatur prorsus: quemadmodū ignis, ne con-
sumatur, soueri ac refici debet noua subinde ligno-

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "[?]ulla" in "ut ulla ratione" is hard to read, the scan shows "ul la" with a break. "cernútur" and "Quód" read with accents as printed. The catchword "rum" stands at the lower right and is the start of the next page. The printed "&" stands for Et. No Greek or Hebrew on the page. The running head "AND. HYPERII" is printed in spaced capitals. The page number "328" is printed top left with a mark before it that is not part of the number.
